'''Druul''' was a [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who owned a [[Druul's droid shop|droid shop]] on [[Vaced/Legends|Vaced]]. In [[43 ABY]], [[Flitcher Poste]] purchased a [[Slicer droid/Legends|slicer droid]] from Druul's droid shop in order to hijack the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']].<ref name="Millennium Falcon" />
